content: As of Sept 2026: Claude Agent SDK / claude -p headless usage authenticates via OAuth credentials at ~/.claude/ (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY needed) and draws from Claude subscription (Pro/Max/Team) usage limits, same as interactive Claude Code. Anthropic announced a June 15 2026 billing change to move SDK/headless usage to a separate dollar-denominated credit pool, but as of June 16 2026 confirmed this had NOT yet taken effect - SDK usage continues on subscription limits as before. This is a moving target Anthropic policy area; revisit before scaling worker usage.
